generation.method: Built-in image_gen tool; resized/exported with sips for exact delivery dimensions.
generation.prompt: Create a production-ready background image for a fictional streaming movie promo named NIGHT SIGNAL, used only as a Peep development demo. Exact output size 1920 x 1080 pixels, landscape 16:9. Cinematic photorealistic still: a lone astronaut beside a weathered radio observatory on a moonlike ridge, large distant planet and fine stars, silver and charcoal monochrome lighting. Main subject and visual detail on the RIGHT half, within the center 1400x800 safe area (260px horizontal margins, 140px vertical margins). Keep the LEFT half very dark, restrained, low-detail negative space for application-rendered headline, subtitle and button; especially keep bottom-left dark and clear. Avoid bright objects in outer margins, keep focal point upper-right of center. Premium film-key-art quality, realistic materials and atmospheric depth, controlled contrast. No text whatsoever, no lettering, no logos, no borders, no watermarks. Black and grey palette, no yellow or blue UI elements. This is artwork only, not a screenshot or mockup.

verification.browser_media_blocker: Safari shows indefinite/zero duration for both HLS and MP4, including a downloaded MP4 served directly on localhost outside Peep. No speculative player changes retained.
verification.storage: Public delivery verified without auth; downloaded SHA-256 matches original. Anonymous listing and upload denied. Admin-only hero upload/select/update policies.
